additional_info.body:
Hello Sakari,
Hope you are doing well.
We analyzed the logs where it is observed one c
onverter cannot be turned on” during Converter Grouping
(F:2, E52). This issue is similar to the one where the fast shutdown did not happen. Additionally, please refer to the KA below for "Fast Shutdown Not Performed" as a reference for troubleshooting.
KA Link:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_PowerConverter_ Fastshutdown not performed - Dynamics 365

2025-04-22T19:07:27.113470+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/a99b21a020b7[637]: PLC-Error-Flag 'PowerConverters' changed from false - ('general error') to true - ('Missing Converters in DC4')
2025-04-22T19:07:27.112409+00:00 [FW060103G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4127] [ONR] DC4 : Outlet not ready - state monitor fastshutdown check error
I recommend carrying a spare power converter while troubleshooting, and if needed, proceed with the replacement.
In further analysis we observed other error of KF214 due to which may cause the Outlet OoO and Missing Converters error. Please also carry a KF214 along with you while visiting site.
Also refer the link below of KA for troubleshooting-
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SiD_HW_StateMonitor_KF214_Missing Converters in DC3 or DC4_Cannot be turned on index - Dynamics 365
